source: Hughes, A.L.C., Gyllencreutz, R., Lohne, Ø.S., Mangerud, J. & Svendsen, J.I. (2016). The last Eurasian ice sheets — a chronological database and time-slice reconstruction, DATED-1. Boreas 45(1), 1–45. https://doi.org/10.1111/bor.12142
changes: Changes were made: time-slice extents reprojected from north-pole Lambert equal-area to WGS84, simplified at 3 km and rounded to 0.01 degrees; the 27, 28–29 and 30–32 ka single extents are carried as most-credible; the 35–38 ka slice has only maximum and minimum; nothing else.
